findings: Only concept components and build_plan changed. Inventor selection, ranking, Wish, product envelope, interaction, six chess-role forms and quantities, landmark mapping, community relief signature, print stance and stated limitations remain the same.

The former board aggregate is truthfully expanded to four distinct 192 x 192 x 6.2 mm printable panels at the unchanged assembly offsets; board_0_0 anchors the signature flag while the concept explicitly retains the shared four-panel civic border.

Seven repeated-geometry families use exact existing representative occurrence keys. Family mapping exhaustively and uniquely covers 68 assembly occurrences and 68 delivered STL files: four panels, 32 inlays and 32 chessmen. Every occurrence in a family has the recorded family mesh SHA and assembly component identity. No extra print quantities are introduced.
All 173 protected CAD sources, STEP/STL files, canonical and detail images, preflight and integrated verification report are byte-identical to the preserved baseline.

The original round-3 blind observations, all 15 critical form requirements, visual verdicts, limitations, image hashes and preflight hash are preserved without semantic edits. Their agreement with the Wish and rendered design is unaffected by this inventory correction.

The full integrated verification PASS predates this metadata amendment and remains untouched. Its original-review SHA is intentionally historical; this amendment records the exact chain from that review to the candidate bound to the corrected concept. No claim of rerunning the full suite against the amended review is made.
root_action_required: Root Manager reviews and adopts or rejects the candidate; root alone runs finalization and returns control to the host.
scope: Independent metadata-only comparison and exact-file binding audit. No CAD generation, geometry modification, image viewing, fresh blind review, physical test, or host gate decision was performed.
